name: Image Shift – Convert, optimize and watermark AVIF & WebP media images
author: digitalpoint

sections.description:
A simple and lightweight plugin that can automatically convert Media images to the WebP or AVIF image format as they are uploaded. Includes the ability to add watermarks to uploaded images.

  • No cost, no subscriptions
  • No reliance on transmitting your images to a third party server
  • Support for multisite networks
  • No third-party PHP libraries are used
  • JavaScript is native (does not use jQuery)

Modern image formats

AVIF images are ~50% smaller than JPEG images, and WebP images are ~30% smaller than JPEG images with the same image quality.
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Navigate to “Plugins” -> Add New
  2. Search for Image Shift
  3. Activate Image Shift from your Plugins area

Manual upload

  1. Download Image Shift
  2. Upload the image-shift directory to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Activate Image Shift from your Plugins area
sections.faq:
Does this work with multisite networks?

Yes. This can be deployed on a per-side basis or network-wide for all sites.

Does this convert images I’ve uploaded in the past?

It does not convert images uploaded before installing this plugin. Changing image extensions and URLs after the fact can lead to issues where previously referenced images no longer work.

If you use Cloudflare (even the Free plan), you can use Image Transformations to automatically convert legacy images to modern formats with the free App for Cloudflare® plugin.

I have an idea for this plugin, can I make a suggestion?

Yes, please do! You can find the suggestion area over here.
